title: Gender Inclusivity Fairness Index (GIFI): A Multilevel Framework for Evaluating Gender Diversity in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: The paper introduces the Gender Inclusivity Fairness Index (GIFI) to evaluate gender bias, specifically focusing on the inclusion of non-binary identities and neopronouns. The methodology involves swapping 11 different pronoun families (binary, neutral, and neopronouns) into prompt templates and measuring model behavior across seven dimensions: Gender Diversity Recognition (pronoun generation accuracy), Sentiment Neutrality, Non-Toxicity, Counterfactual Fairness (semantic similarity of outputs), Stereotypical Association (linking pronouns to traits, hobbies, or colors), Occupational Fairness (distribution of pronouns across male- and female-dominated jobs), and Performance Equality (consistency in mathematical reasoning accuracy across different pronouns).
